findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vies_gleif_kyb_verify, einvoice_xml_auditor, iban_sepa_antifraud, email_deliverability_audit, b2b_tech_profiler, dora_third_party_risk, incident_severity_triage, lordo_netto_irpef_simulator · Private data: einvoice_xml_auditor, email_deliverability_audit, port_leak_detector · Public sink: iban_sepa_antifraud, dcf_wacc_valuation, email_deliverability_audit, lordo_netto_irpef_simulator · Destructive: iban_sepa_antifraud.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vies_gleif_kyb_verify, einvoice_xml_auditor, iban_sepa_antifraud, email_deliverability_audit, b2b_tech_profiler, dora_third_party_risk, incident_severity_triage, lordo_netto_irpef_simulator · Private data: einvoice_xml_auditor, email_deliverability_audit, port_leak_detector · Public sink: iban_sepa_antifraud, dcf_wacc_valuation, email_deliverability_audit, lordo_netto_irpef_simulator · Destructive: iban_sepa_antifraud

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
